baseline_models.focus_anchor: The asking construction at word 1 and the anchoring noun at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question seeks the point at which the Hour passes from not-yet-established to fixed, actual, and irreversible occurrence.

activation_trace.role: Asking and requesting make the utterance an active demand for disclosure rather than a neutral mention.
Fixity and rooted stability turn the requested 'when' into the point at which the event becomes established.

changed_reading.before: They ask for the date of the Hour.
changed_reading.after: They ask when the Hour will become a fixed and irreversible reality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Hour at word 3 and its anchoring at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: An image of unattended going meets the vessel's mooring: the Hour is imagined as presently unbounded in motion until a stopping point arrests it.

activation_trace.role: Unattended going supplies the Hour's tentative image as something still proceeding without a bounded station.
A vessel's stopping place gives the anchoring noun a concrete endpoint that arrests movement.

changed_reading.before: The Hour is a hidden point already sitting on a timeline.
changed_reading.after: The Hour is pictured as unmoored until its eventual arrival at a holding point.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence applies the same anchoring root to solid mountains. This material echo revises the focus from an abstract date into an eventual act of setting the Hour firmly in reality.

activation_trace.role: The focus noun carries the literal possibility of becoming fixed and rooted.
The mountain as a high solid mass supplies the concrete body that receives stabilization.
The same root enacts imposed stability on mountains and makes the focus anchoring materially legible.

structural_cues: 79:32 places the exact focus root in a concrete creation sequence after earth-making and before provision.
The context verb and focus noun both carry a feminine object or possessive ending.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mountain solidity and an exact anchoring-root echo; I infer an analogy from stabilizing mountains to actualizing the Hour. A live alternative is simple lexical recurrence with no shared mechanism.

changed_reading.after: When will the Hour be set into reality, analogously to the mountains being set firm?

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate response replaces the requested temporal object with reminder, assigns the endpoint to the Lord, and restricts the messenger to warning. The question is therefore exposed as seeking the wrong kind of access.

activation_trace.role: The object of request makes concealed timing the thing sought from the messenger.
The sought datum concerns the event's point of fixation.
Reminder shifts available speech away from timetable disclosure and toward recollection and admonition.
A terminus at which a thing ends supplies the endpoint assigned to the Lord.
Warning that awakens caution defines the messenger's authorized response to uncertainty.

structural_cues: The three ayat immediately after the question answer by role and ownership rather than by a date.
Repeated feminine pronouns keep the reminder, endpoint, and feared object tied to the Hour, while the restrictive particle in 79:45 limits the messenger's function.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, divine endpoint, and warning; I infer that uncertainty is redirected into readiness. The live alternative is only an epistemic refusal without an ethical redirection.

changed_reading.before: They seek a calendar answer from the messenger.
changed_reading.after: They seek disclosure from the wrong office: the endpoint belongs to the Lord, while the messenger can turn uncertainty only into reminder and warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the close, seeing the Hour compresses the remembered stay to an evening or its forenoon. The event's fixation thus changes the scale on which 'when' can be understood: arrival retrospectively contracts ordinary duration.

activation_trace.role: Fixation supplies the threshold after which temporal perspective can be remeasured.
Direct seeing supplies the experiential point from which the earlier duration is reassessed.
Staying in a place supplies the duration that undergoes retrospective compression.
The evening period supplies one short temporal bound for the compressed stay.
The extending forenoon supplies the alternate short span against which the stay is measured.

structural_cues: The only explicit temporal approximation after the question is retrospective rather than calendrical.
The feminine object first asked about in 79:42 is directly seen in 79:46.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeing and a radically brief estimate of prior staying; I infer that the Hour's arrival causes the perspective shift. A live alternative is that 79:46 only belittles worldly duration without altering the force of the focus interrogative.

changed_reading.before: The interrogative asks for a point on an ordinary temporal scale.
changed_reading.after: The Hour is the threshold that collapses the ordinary temporal scale, so its 'when' becomes experiential rather than merely calendrical.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired final abodes immediately before the focus combine with the vessel-mooring image: the Hour's anchoring becomes the threshold that gathers people into opposed settled destinations.

activation_trace.role: A vessel's mooring contributes arrival at a destination that stops further travel.
Joining a gathering place supplies one final destination on the negative branch of the contrast.
The repeated gathering-place image supplies the opposed final destination.

structural_cues: 79:39 and 79:41 repeat the same copular frame for opposed abodes immediately before the focus question.
The moral contrast in 79:37-41 sorts people before the question asks about the Hour's anchoring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mooring image and two gathering abodes; I infer that the event's settlement entails human placement. A live alternative keeps the Hour's anchoring and the persons' abodes as unrelated referents.

changed_reading.before: They ask only when the Hour itself will arrive.
changed_reading.after: They ask about the threshold whose arrival will also fix people in their final abodes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the packet's form-distant secondary mapping rather than the ordinary semantics of asking. It remains anchored to focus word 1 and concretely recasts interrogation as drawing out a concealed datum; downstream prose should label it exploratory wordplay, not a lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 through its packet-supplied secondary mapped root.

activation_trace.role: Gentle, hidden extraction turns the act of questioning into an attempt to draw the concealed date out of the addressee.

changed_reading.after: The questioners attempt to extract a concealed timing from the messenger.

strongest_changes: The exact mountain-root echo recasts an abstract date as an enacted cosmic stabilization.
The reminder-endpoint-warning sequence redirects information-seeking into readiness under divine ownership.
The closing evening-or-forenoon estimate makes the Hour's arrival retroactively compress ordinary duration.
summary.what_was_special: The anchoring noun supported several non-collapsible mechanisms: material fixation, nautical stopping, human settlement into opposed abodes, and an endpoint outside the messenger's authority.
remaining_uncertainties: The nautical and abode linkage may be a branch-licensed exploration rather than an intended shared spatial mechanism.
The final duration simile may alter only perspective on worldly time, not the semantics of the interrogative itself.
The concealed-extraction outlier remains form-distant and should not be promoted beyond exploratory status.
